headline: Iran adviser warns Iraq must not become a tool of Donald Trump
label: NEWS
caption:
Iran warns Iraq against US pressure. 🚨

Mohammad Mokhber, an adviser to Iran Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei, warned Iraq in a post on X that it must not become a tool of Donald Trump, according to Middle East Eye.

The warning follows media reports that Iraq had closed several crossings after US efforts to blockade Iran land borders.

Mokhber stated that an unbreakable bond with Iran requires Baghdad to remain vigilant on borders so it does not become a tool of the enemies of Islam.
